label: preparing
what: A secret jubilee celebration, very likely marking my forty years as mayor, in the great hall at eighteen hundred under cover of a lighting inspection. Baker and Builder are arranging jubilee bread supplies; Innkeeper is coordinating two hundred fresh loaves and the hall meeting, with private financial help from Freight. Builder requested secrecy until eighteen. The secretary has helped schedule the ostensible inspection, but there is insufficient evidence that she knowingly helped conceal the celebration.
